name: WMATA API
tagline: Real-time DC Metro rail, bus, and incident data for transit apps
description: Official Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) developer API providing real-time rail and bus predictions, station and route information, service incidents, elevator/escalator status, and GTFS-compatible transit data for the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter or api_key header; self-serve signup at developer.wmata.com

use_cases: get next train arrivals for a Metro station
list all Metro rail stations and lines
get bus predictions for a stop
fetch current service incidents and alerts
